decision.summary: Within allowed context [570,729], the dominant motion is a prolonged, monotonic E decline (~3.7 → -28) paired with steady N rise (~0.4 → 7.5) and persistently negative U; no recovery is observed, ruling out a temporary offset for the main trend. A localized flattening in E around indices 660–670 is the only candidate for a temporary offset: it shows a discernible deceleration in E descent, but lacks a clear opposing return edge and coincides with uninterrupted N/U trends. Hence, status is uncertain.

intervals.observation: E component shows a brief flattening (less negative slope) from index ~660 to 670, while N continues rising and U remains negative; the E trend resumes steep decline after 670 with no opposing return observed within allowed context. Interior is sustained but short-lived; onset and return are observable on E, though co-occurring N/U trends are monotonic and lack reversal.
